name: Greencrest Financial Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Greencrest Financial Services Ltd is in the business of financing and investment activities in Shares and Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is RBI registered Non Deposit Taking NBFC and is in the business of finance and investments. Company is carrying trading/ investment activities in both Equity and FNO Segment and trading in Commodities market apart from its financing activities. Company 
also deals in Government and Non Government Bonds, Fixed Deposits, Commodities and other related activities of capital market

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 123 days to 70.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.22% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
